name: popsicle
headline: AI-Powered Lead Generation & Marketing Automation
short_description: Business Leads AI Automation is an open-source tool designed for SMEs and agencies, combining Google Maps scraping with AI-driven email and WhatsApp marketing templates to streamline lead generation and marketing efforts.
author: asiifdev

sections.overview:
Business Leads AI Automation generates qualified business leads by scraping contact information from Google Maps, then uses OpenAI to create personalized email and WhatsApp marketing content automatically. The tool includes a modern web dashboard for managing campaigns, tracking lead quality with AI scoring, and exporting results in CSV or JSON formats. It's built for digital agencies, freelance marketers, and SME consultants who need an affordable, self-hosted alternative to expensive lead generation platforms. Setup takes minutes with an interactive wizard that configures your business profile, API keys, and language preferences. The solution handles the entire workflow: search, data extraction, AI content generation, and campaign management—all without leaving the dashboard.
Generate leads using Google Maps data
Automate email outreach with AI templates
Enhance WhatsApp marketing campaigns
Streamline marketing processes for SMEs
sections.usage:
```
I'm using Business Leads AI Automation to generate marketing content for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. Please create 3 personalized email templates and 2 WhatsApp message templates for our lead generation campaign. The business specializes in [SERVICE] and targets [TARGET_AUDIENCE]. Use a professional yet friendly tone.
```
